title: Afsos aj zainab e dilgeer margayi
body:
AFSOUS AJ ZAINAB-E-DILGEER MARGAYI
ZEHRA KI JAAN HUSSAIN KI HUMSHEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
ROTE HAIN AJ SANIYE ZEHRA KO MURTAZA…..
ROTE HAIN AJ SANIYE ZEHRA KO MURTAZA…..
<<DIVIDER>>
AFSOUS FATIMA KI WO TASVEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
QHUTBAO MEIN JISKE HAIDER-E-SAFDAR KA THA JALAL…..
QHUTBAO MEIN JISKE HAIDER-E-SAFDAR KA THA JALAL…..
<<DIVIDER>>
WO SHER-E-KIRDGAR KI TAASEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
ZEENATH THI JIS GHARIB SE SARWAR KE AAL KI…..
ZEENATH THI JIS GHARIB SE SARWAR KE AAL KI…..
<<DIVIDER>>
WO PASBANE ITRATTE TATHEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
MARA SHAQI NE BELCHA SAR PAR GHAREEB KEY…..
MARA SHAQI NE BELCHA SAR PAR GHAREEB KEY…..
<<DIVIDER>>
SADME MEIN SE JISKE HAYE WO DILGEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
BACHPAN SE THI JO AALE MOHAMMED KI SO SOUGWAAR…..
BACHPAN SE THI JO AALE MOHAMMED KI SO SOUGWAAR…..
<<DIVIDER>>
WO GHAMZADA HUSSAIN KI HUMSHEER MARGAYI
<<MINI>>
MAZHAR GHAME HUSSAIN KI MAJLIS JO KI BAPA…..
MAZHAR GHAME HUSSAIN KI MAJLIS JO KI BAPA…..
<<DIVIDER>>
WO YADGARE HAZRATE SHABBIR MARGAYI
